name: app-runtime-spike
description: M12-01 risk-gate spike: sandboxed app runtime (esbuild + react-native-web in a sandboxed iframe / WebView), sqlite3def, WAL read-only. See README.md.

scripts.build: node build/build-runtime.mjs && node build/build-runtime.mjs --dev && node build/compile-app.mjs apps/groceries --out dist/groceries.app.js
scripts.exp:expo-web: node build/gen-expo-assets.mjs && cd expo-host && npx expo export -p web && cd .. && node tests/expo-web.e2e.mjs
scripts.exp:all: npm run exp:compile && npm run exp:sandbox && npm run exp:expo-web && npm run exp:webview && npm run exp:router && npm run exp:smoke && npm run exp:schema && npm run exp:wal
